items.info: 84. Generate one highly memorable image. Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. Style: a vivid anime illustration in the style of the One Piece anime (Eiichiro Oda's manga style): bold clean ink outlines, bright saturated cel-shaded colour, expressive exaggerated characters, dynamic adventurous composition, every object crisp and instantly recognisable. Colour scheme: misty sea teal with a blaze of rainbow and poison green. Composition: ONE dominant focal point that the eye finds at once, drawn boldly and larger than life, in the centre and in the strongest light: the very tall felt hat climber with his crossed ice axes and forked staff clutching to the front of his chest the big cracked egg, its shell rough, spiky and rainbow-coloured. It carries the main message. Around it only the elements described below, each clearly recognisable for what it is, in its own place in the frame and linked to the focal point, smaller than it but never tiny or muddled. Nothing decorative: no crowd, no extra people, no props or background details that are not described. Faces full of feeling. Scene: A misty dock on an island of the Grand Line. In the centre, in the strongest light: a stranger, a very tall, long-limbed mountain climber in a grey felt hat, with two crossed ice axes on his back and a Y-shaped forked staff in his hand, clutches to the very front of his chest a big strange cracked egg glowing from inside, its shell rough, spiky and rainbow-coloured, a little red crab peeking out of the crack. Chopper, the ship's reindeer doctor, pours a chemist's flask of bubbling poison-green potion over the rough egg, and a carpenter's saw cuts away a shrunken leftover lump of shell. A stork and a fluffy alpaca stand by the rough egg, both shrinking as it shrinks. Beside them a smooth pale egg melts like snow under thin violet rays from a lamp. Far below on the beach lies a nest of many eggs. These objects carry the meaning, so each must be unmistakable and clearly recognisable for what it is: a big strange cracked egg glowing from inside, its shell rough, spiky and rainbow-coloured; a very tall, long-limbed mountain climber in a grey felt hat, two crossed ice axes on his back and a Y-shaped forked staff in his hand; Chopper pouring a chemist's flask of bubbling poison-green potion over the rough egg; a lamp shooting thin violet rays; a little red crab peeking out of the rough egg's crack; a smooth pale egg melting like snow under the violet rays; a stork perched by the rough egg, shrinking as the egg shrinks; a fluffy alpaca beside the rough egg, shrinking with it; a carpenter's saw cutting away a shrunken leftover piece of shell; a nest of many eggs on the beach far below; a shrunken leftover lump of rough shell after the potion; the very front of the climber's chest, where the egg sits. Every object must be visually meaningful, distinctive and easy to recall, and all of them must be linked by physical interaction and cause-and-effect inside this one scene. No literal anatomy, no organs, no medical equipment, no unrelated objects. No written text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image. These details matter most and must be painted exactly as stated: the climber is a stranger, not Luffy or any Straw Hat; no letters are written anywhere, not even on his hat. Save the image with the file name 84 and upload it to: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/11gZ6LUEbDqbeyBc45sVLsKRQ6gpwLtdx
